description: Single source of truth for LCES failure codes shared by the Python adapter and the Motion Canvas Node driver. Terminal states are 'failed' or 'cancelled'; a build may reach exactly one of them.

unsupported_platform.description: The host platform is outside the admitted P1 range (Linux only).

environment_unavailable.description: A required tool or dependency is missing or the wrong version.

dependency_mismatch.description: The installed dependency tree does not match the pinned lockfile.

invalid_input.description: The scene set, video contract, or template data is invalid.

driver_protocol_mismatch.description: The editor UI or driver protocol does not match the pinned version.

render_failed.description: The driver exited non-zero or crashed for an unmapped reason.

cancelled.description: The build was cancelled by the caller.

output_missing.description: The driver produced no report, frames, or video.

frame_mismatch.description: The frame count or timeline deviates from the contract by more than one frame.

output_corrupt.description: A frame or media file failed structural or decode validation.

encode_failed.description: FFmpeg encoding failed or produced an unusable file.

qa_failed.description: Post-render QA (frame manifest, ffprobe, subtitles) failed.
